membership_rule: review class 'accepted_authorship_disagrees'; authorship difference 'different_authorship': none of the above: the accepted authorships name different authors or differ in a way no rule above reads (for example an abbreviation); and, read as if the accepted name keys agreed, review class 'ordinary': both accepted usages are species, the accepted name keys (canonical name plus authorship) agree, at least one shared synonym is of kind 'ordinary', and not low overlap (a single 'ordinary' shared synonym while each source publishes at least 5 synonyms)

nortaxa_col_source.matched_on: COL source/<id>.yaml title == NorTaxa eml.xml dataset title

note: Immutable review input. It approves nothing: a Group-B pair becomes a supersession or mapping only through an owner decision recorded in the plan that names this file's file_sha256 (batch) or the pair (individual). Membership is pinned to the release and source archives below and never extends to taxa in a later source release. Members are in cloud-impact order (COL side in the cloud scope, then NorTaxa side with vernaculars, then identifier). shared_synonyms and shared_synonym_evidence list at most 10 names; the counts are exact.

synonym_kinds.accepted_name_reauthored: the canonical name is either accepted name itself, under another authorship
synonym_kinds.illegitimate: an explicit textual warning: the authorship carries 'nom. illeg.', or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'nom. illeg.' or 'later homonym' (the structured statuses NorTaxa 'illegitimate' and COL 'unacceptable' are not used)
synonym_kinds.interpretation_qualified: a misapplied usage (NorTaxa nomenclaturalStatus or COL col:status 'misapplied'), or the authorship carries a sensu-style qualifier ('sensu', 's.', 'ss.', 'auct.')
synonym_kinds.name_variant: no structured status applies, but the name is almost spelled like either accepted name: same word count once hyphens are removed, and every word, genus included, within Levenshtein distance 2 (a possible misspelling or a near-identical combination, unconfirmed by the sources)
synonym_kinds.nortaxa_derived: otherwise ordinary, but every COL usage behind it comes from the COL source that is NorTaxa (see nortaxa_col_source): COL republishes NorTaxa's assertion, so the two sources do not independently corroborate it
synonym_kinds.not_validly_published: NorTaxa nomenclaturalStatus 'notvalidlypublished', COL col:nameStatus 'not established', the authorship carries 'nom. nud.' or 'nom. inval.', or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'nom. nud.', 'nom. inval.' or 'published without a valid description'
synonym_kinds.ordinary: meets none of the tests above
synonym_kinds.orthographic_variant: either source's structured status marks the usage an orthographic variant (NorTaxa nomenclaturalStatus 'orthographic')
synonym_kinds.pro_parte: COL col:status 'ambiguous synonym', or the authorship carries 'p.p.' or 'pro parte'
synonym_kinds.unauthored: the authorship is empty, so the match is on the name alone
synonym_kinds.unpublished: COL col:nameStatus 'manuscript', or the authorship or a COL usage's col:remarks/col:nameRemarks carries 'ined' or 'nom. herb.'
